summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all four paragraphs of the selected Greek. Neither presents a concrete fidelity defect: both retain the flesh/spirit distinctions, justification assertion, exclusive divine ability to heal, conditional healing promise, inseparability of defilement, and negative and future-life assertions. The notes distinguish bracketed editorial restorations and the daggered reading from preserved text, retain the disclosed working readings, and accurately reflect the bounded comparison reports supplied. Acceptance concerns fidelity to this working source and disclosure of those reports; it does not authenticate unseen images, certify the cited editions, or constitute exhaustive manuscript collation.
